record_title: A logarithmic Fock weight has the full diagonal Calkin corona
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: Specific to the displayed logarithmic radial weight and bounded radial symbols. The theorem identifies the radial Toeplitz algebra only modulo compact operators; it does not assert operator-norm equality with the full U(n)-intertwiner algebra or classify general weights. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
